id.description: Globally unique identifier for this action.

ifsId.description: IFS system identifier for this Action.

entityType.description: Entity category for this object, normally Action.

basedOn.description: Id of the object this object is derived from.

entityDocumentationUrl.description: URL for documentation about this entity.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when this action record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when this action record was last updated.

uniqueName.description: Stable unique name used by IFS implementations to identify this action.

requiresPermission.description: Whether a member or role must hold an applicable permission before performing this action.

instructions.description: Instructions for how to perform the action.

warnings.description: Warnings, risks, or constraints to review before performing this action.
